data.fund_type: An Open Ended Dynamic Asset Allocation Fund
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to provide capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity related instruments including derivatives and debt and money market instruments. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related instruments (including units issued by REITs) :- 0-100% Debt & Money Market instruments including Units of Debt oriented mutual fund schemes:- 0-100% Foreign securities including ADRs / GDRs / Foreign equity and debt securities:- 0-35%
data.benchmark: Nifty Fifty Hybrid Composite debt 50:50 Index
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP) within 15 days from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 1% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme
